title: Implement project inventory and project detail views
objective: Replace the projects route placeholders with the project inventory, project detail, deployment history, environment matrix, domain, repository, secret-policy, and activity views from the design reference.
actions: Replace projectRoutes.tsx placeholder exports with route elements for /projects and /projects/:projectId.
Implement ProjectListPage with summary metrics, filter toolbar, project inventory table, and an alternate operations-board lane layout where it fits the responsive constraints.

Implement ProjectDetailPage with project header, production/staging/preview environment matrix, deployment history table, repository metadata, domain status, redacted secret-policy summary, and recent control-plane events.
Wire pages to the fixture-backed API boundary and render explicit loading, error, empty, and stale-data states for projects, deployments, route revisions, and events.
Use shared Button, Panel, DataTable, StatusPill, and Timeline primitives from TASK-001 without adding a parallel UI system.
Keep project tables horizontally scrollable on narrow screens and use non-color text labels for all route, artifact, build, and channel statuses.
Ensure all secret-related UI uses redacted metadata and never raw secret values from fixtures.

files.purpose: route exports for project list and detail
project-specific summary, table, matrix, rail, and activity components
route and component tests for project views

new_tests: ProjectListPage renders active project summary, deployment count, routing revision summary, protected artifact count, and the project inventory table.
ProjectDetailPage renders production, staging, previews, deployment history, repository metadata, domains, redacted secret policy, and recent events.
Project views render no-project, paused-project, route-drift, queued-build, and API-error states from fixtures.
Secret canary strings from fixture internals are not present in rendered project pages.

criteria: src/features/projects/projectRoutes.tsx no longer imports RoutePlaceholder and exports route elements for project list and detail.
The /projects rendered route contains text labels Projects, Project inventory, Active projects, Routing revisions, Protected artifacts, and at least one project name from fixtures.
The /projects/:projectId rendered route contains text labels Deployment history, Repository, Domains, Production, Staging, Previews, and Recent events.
Project-related status pills include visible text for Healthy, Build queued, Route drift, Routed, Verified, and Protected or their fixture equivalents.
npm test -- --run src/features/projects/projects.test.tsx and npm run build pass.

risks: Dense tables can overflow or hide actions on mobile if DataTable wrappers are not used.
Project settings can accidentally expose webhook secrets or environment values if fixture redaction is bypassed.
Preview deployments are P1, so the project detail should show preview-compatible state without implying full preview workflow completion.

execution.findings: Implemented project inventory/detail routes with fixture-backed data, responsive project table, environment matrix, deployment history, settings rail, activity timeline, stale/error/empty states, and redaction-placeholder guards for repeated fixture references.
execution.tests_passed: npm test -- --run src/features/projects/projects.test.tsx passed (8 tests); npm run build passed.
